title: Huge cell text ods 002
notes: real spreadsheet text stress: 400 rows x one cell, each holding the unique deterministic ~158-char string row{r:03d} + ' shared-text-stress' * 8. ODS has no sharedStrings table at all — every cell repeats its string literally in XML, so this is shared-text stress in the deflate/DOM sense: 63 KB of literal text with massive substring repetition across cells, which SAX/DOM readers must surface without truncation. Reference text is the exact same string(s), byte-for-byte as inserted, no truncation allowed. Deflate collapses the repetitive text hard: saved blob is 5092 bytes, far under the 10 MB cap. The normative counter reads table:table=1. Overflow/wrap/print-area behavior over the giant strings is the fixture's point.
